text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Fan Appreciation Festival. It's a 
familiar event where fans are invited to 
Tracen Academy, but...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: One, two, one, two♪
choice_data_list: Gran, what should we do today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Various competitions and performances will 
be held, but I haven't decided which ones 
to take part in yet.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any specific race I want to 
enter. However...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I've already decided what I'm going to do!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria dashed toward the pool, where 
the voices were noticeably louder.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume MC
text_block_list.text:
Look at that! Countless fans are swarming 
around the poolside! And it's no wonder—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume MC
text_block_list.text:
Triple Tiara Umamusume, the world-renowned 
Almond Eye makes her appearance! Today, 
she'll be competing in the 200m freestyle!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume MC
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume currently drawing the most 
attention! Just what kind of swimming 
performance will she show us?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to working with you. 
It might not be a race today, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I will win! Without fail!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A fan event focused on fun. However, 
Almond Eye seemed to have no intention of 
playing around."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is the Uma Musume known as Almond 
Eye. And—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ai-senpai, I look forward to working with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan? Were you always good at 
swimming?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm good at all kinds of sports. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm not entering this event just because 
it's my forte.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Then—why?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Because Ai-senpai is running!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Today's showdown is in swimming!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "A match, huh... —Fine, let's do this."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume MC
text_block_list.text:
"Things have taken an unbelievable turn! 
Almond Eye vs. Gran Alegria!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume MC
text_block_list.text:
A dream showdown comes to life at the Fan 
Appreciation Festival!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(Ai-senpai's strength—her true greatness, 
I still haven't fully grasped it yet.)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I want to know it, I want to feel it! 
Right here, right now, today!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ai-senpai, I look forward to working with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A declaration of challenge full of vigor. 
And with that, the two super athletes dove 
in like flying fish.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hmph, hah!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel it...! Ai-senpai's pressure, 
her fighting spirit, from beyond the 
water...!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(This feeling... I've finally found one! 
For the first time, an Umamusume living at 
the same depth as me!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: (I want to win! No matter what...!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(With my power! With my ability! There's 
no way I can lose!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neither of them are swimming pros. Even 
so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them instinctively know how to 
use their bodies. The springiness unique 
to Umamusume flexes—

text_block_list.name: Gran & Ai
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh! Haaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Go for it, Almond Eye~!! Show us your 
ultimate swim!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: GO! GO! Ai! GO! GO! Ai!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, Almond Eye still had 
far more supporters. And the result was—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume MC
text_block_list.text:
An overwhelming victory for Almond Eye! 
Gran Alegria couldn't reach her!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume MC
text_block_list.text:
The immense cheers have ignited Almond 
Eye's fighting spirit!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
No! Gran Alegria!! In terms of ability, 
they're equal! Show us your potential!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Among racing connoisseurs, there were 
surprisingly many who held Gran Alegria in 
high regard.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume MC
text_block_list.text:
A narrow victory for Almond Eye! Gran 
Alegria falls just short!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume MC
text_block_list.text:
They're neck and neck! Gran Alegria isn't 
being outmatched in raw physical ability 
in the slightest!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa... So strong... absurdly 
so... But...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(For the first time... I was able to feel 
it...! The real Ai-senpai!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-senpai, thank you so much for today. 
Next time—"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Let's make it the Yasuda Kinen! Our 
ultimate showdown!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely win the mile race, my 
absolute forte. Yes, the upcoming Yasuda 
Kinen is my chance—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Here comes the final mile toward the 
changing of the guard!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: “—Right. Then that last mile will be...”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It'll never be bridged. The one who wins 
is me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Neither yielding an inch in their 
declarations of victory. To the fans, 
there was no greater service."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm just so, so excited for the 
showdown with Ai-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Body and soul, I might be at my absolute 
hottest!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it everything we've got!
Yeah, let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bursting flames. Most likely, this year's 
Yasuda Kinen will be—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This will be a day that goes down in 
racing history. No one knows yet whose 
name will be engraved as the victor.
